caption: 🚨WATCH: 🇱🇧Passenger elevator collapses after two men overload it with heavy tiles.
A viral surveillance video from Beirut, Lebanon shows the moment a passenger elevator suddenly collapses after being overloaded with a large quantity of heavy tiles. ￼

According to reports circulating online, the incident occurred on March 31, 2026, when two men attempted to transport the heavy construction materials inside the elevator. The excess weight caused the system to fail, sending the cabin dropping down the shaft before crashing at the bottom. ￼

Both men were seriously injured and taken to hospital, though early reports indicate they survived the fall. The incident has sparked discussion online about overloading elevators and poor maintenance in older buildings. ￼
